derivation: The same five statements that raise under ANSI mode, re-run with spark.sql.ansi.enabled set to false for one transfer test. union_int_and_text: without ANSI the common type of INT and STRING is STRING, so every unit becomes text and no error is raised: 19 unit values (one NULL) plus the five machine identifiers = 24 rows, listed here sorted as text with NULL first. strict_cast_units: CAST returns NULL instead of raising for 'n/a' and '1,200'; the other four values convert as TRY_CAST does. plain_division: 0 / 0 for I-104 returns NULL instead of DIVIDE_BY_ZERO. element_at_all_rows and bracket_all_rows: an index past the end of an empty array returns NULL instead of raising; I-100 and I-102 keep their first codes (SCRATCH, DENT).
